Internal helper: the example line under jsave()'s front-door stops

Source: R/io.R
dot-jst_jsave_example_lines.Rd

The stops for a data argument that is not found, cannot be evaluated, is NULL or is not a data frame each gave "Provide a data frame, e.g. jsave(MyData, "mydata.sav")" on the line of the sentence before it. Since Session 368 (Fix Slate 15) each gives "Provide a data frame, for example:" and the call on a line of its own (Rules E and L), the call naming the one data frame in the workspace, as the no-default stop has since Session 367 (MyData when there is none or there are several). The file is "mydata.sav", except under the stop for a name not found – most often a misspelled data frame – where the file the call gave is kept when it is a quoted name: jsave(communty, "community.sav") is offered jsave(community, "community.sav"). An object that exists but is not a data frame keeps the example file, since the file the call named was meant for that object.

Usage

.jst_jsave_example_lines(mc, envir, keep_file = FALSE)

Arguments

mc

The call, matched (match.call() in jsave()).

envir

The caller's environment, where the data frames are looked for.

keep_file

Logical; keep the call's file name in the example.

Value

Character(1); the "Provide a data frame, for example:" heading and the call, two lines.
